summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for upgrading Vashisht Ply House with an automated GST billing engine (Intra/Inter-state tax detection, dual pricing toggle, dynamic unit calculations), persistent Product Master catalog with pre-loaded hardware/plywood inventory in a tabbed Settings modal, live item autocompletion, hybrid HSN selection, and statutory 3-copy A4 print generation (Original, Duplicate, Triplicate).
